items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: But I remember Dominick Cortese and his wife and somebody would have a party.

ctx.x: It was lonely. I mean I had the children, thank goodness. But he was gone all week long and then maybe Saturday night we could get to go out if we had a sitter, babysitters. But I remember Dominick Cortese and his wife and somebody would have a party. It was like wow, we’re going out tonight.

That’s interesting that you say on Saturday night, because where I’m from, in Upstate New York, Saturday night is usually a night you’d be working. But during the studio years that might not have been — unless you had a jazz gig or something.
